answer: Yes: R4 is the quality problem reactor. Grades: R4 has 1 A / 178 B / 72 C of ~251 runs (about 29% C, almost no A) vs R1 138/106/7, R3 131/112/2; R2 is also weaker (79 A / 126 B / 45 C, 18% C). Yield is NOT the issue: mean CNT yield R1 25.6, R2 25.5, R3 24.7, R4 26.2 g/g-cat (R4 highest). Candidate cause for R4: residual metal is ~4.7 wt% vs ~3.4 for R1-R3 (about +1.3 wt%), a constant offset from week 1 and across all R4 catalyst lots (FC-2602..2608, 4.35-5.03; slightly higher in FC-2606~2608), so it looks reactor-specific rather than lot-specific; all reactors drift up ~0.5 wt% after week ~14. IG/ID is also lower for R4 (2.41) and R2 (2.48) vs R1/R3 (2.67). Not explained by 2-zone temperature, H2/C2H4 ratio, residence time, or uptime (all essentially the same as other reactors). Downtime causes are similar across reactors (R4 slightly highest in heater failure ~2900 min and misc 961 min). Suggest checking R4 hardware/purification/catalyst-removal path; R2 needs a separate look (C-grade 45 but residual metal normal).
